name: Vampiric Dragon
description: A dragon that takes pleasure in killing cattle and is killed by a jucarri demon.

description_citations.text: "The Monsters of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A summoned jucarri demon kills the Vampiric Dragon and tears itself apart.
timeline.quote: It works, and the dragon is killed, and the jucarri demon tears itself apart.

citation.text: "The Monsters of Magic", section "Seasons of Slaughter , by Vance Moore". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
